reason: Every picomatch version (<= 4.0.7) is affected and no fix is published. It is reached only through build and lint tooling (tailwindcss, chokidar, fast-glob, tinyglobby, typescript-eslint) on our own source globs, never in the shipped app or on user input. npm's suggested fix downgrades vite to 6.2.7 and does not remove picomatch.
